title: Raycast testimonials
description: A two-tone heading, a row of people with the active one lifted into a softly glowing bordered card and the neighbours dim and clipped by faded edges, a hairline that fades at both ends, then a mono-labelled pair of rows (favourite feature, top extension) beside a vertical rule and a large quote with bold highlighted words. The active person advances every 5 seconds.
notes: autoplay is off under reduced motion; people can be chosen by clicking
needs JavaScript (state and timer); static HTML shows the first person
avatars are slots (muted circles when empty)
name: raycast-testimonials

props.name: labels
props.description: the mono labels of the two rows

props.name: interval
props.description: how long each person stays, in ms (default 5000)
